description: This file defines the interface class IGstWebAudioPlayerClient, which is used for notification callbacks related to the state of a web audio player within the Rialto gstreamer media framework. It includes licensing information, include guards, necessary includes, and a single pure virtual method notifyState that informs the client of state changes.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for clients to receive notifications about the web audio player's state changes.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current web audio player state.
